results.name: first-visit
results.note: coach and best move on, warnings and highlights off; no eval bar, timeline, tabs or engine odds; the move list with grades and %; the best-move arrow

results.name: corner-blunder
results.note: Down from a 2048 snake: listed and graded "Blunder · Takes your 2048 out of its corner"; with Warn me the move is stopped and the coach's Right taken

results.name: edge-blunder
results.note: Down from a 4096 snake pulls the 2048 off the edge: "Blunder"

results.name: random-keys
results.note: 14 random keys from a 2048 position: 5 flagged (Blunder, Best, Questionable, Blunder, Questionable, Questionable); the first after 1 moves

results.name: early-corner
results.note: one Best in the list; Down from a 128 opening: "QuestionableTakes your 128 out of its cornerCoach: → RightUndo", no warning

results.name: coach-toggles
results.note: Highlights: none before a move, then 1-3 fault cells after a blunder; Best move off hides the arrow and the list, not the grade; Explain adds reasons and the plan; Coach off folds the panel and Space/P do nothing; engine odds as cards behind a link

results.name: blocked-chain
results.note: Explain on a blocked chain: "Chain blocked. The 128 in the top row, third column blocks your chain: merge it away or rebuild the chain around it."

results.name: grades-only
results.note: coach off + Grades only: no list or arrow, Down graded "Blunder" with nothing else; Why? opens the coach with the reason and its move; a best move shows just "Best"

results.name: keyboard-undo
results.note: 30 arrow moves + 5 coach moves (Space), Z x3 + X (at 32 of 34), the arrow plays the coach's move

results.name: autoplay
results.note: "10" plays 10 moves, "100" 100 more, "Next tile" stops by itself, P starts and Esc stops (now at move 143)

results.name: branch-restore
results.note: 100 coach moves, back 50, a different move from the list replaced 50; "Undo" in the toast restored them (50/100)

results.name: review
results.note: 10 coach moves + 8 own keys: review counts {"Blunder":0,"Questionable":1,"Good":3,"Best":3} (the coach's left out); 1 flagged to revisit, a click jumps there

results.name: game-over
results.note: Right on a near-dead board ends the game; the game-over card offers Undo, Review, New game; Undo goes back

results.name: editor
results.note: the menu opens the editor on the board; tiles placed with the palette get the coach's move list; Play from here starts there (the old game restorable)

results.name: not-judged-block
results.note: an expert block formation: the moves are "Not judged"

results.name: offline
results.note: 4 moves offline; the panel says "The coach is offline"; autoplay stops with a message

results.name: persistence
results.note: a reload keeps the game (93/100); a v2 line with old facts opens; v2 Coach mode opens as Warn me without Best move

results.name: shortcuts-how-dark
results.note: ? opens the shortcuts, Esc closes them; C toggles the coach; How on desktop and phone; dark phone with a blunder
